item_name: Invasive Mechanical Ventilator (ventilator or respirator) — O0110F1, columns a (On Admission), b (While a Resident), c (At Discharge)

lookback_source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs that the resident received or performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the last 14 days.

lookback_notes: O0110 uses column-specific assessment periods. Column b (While a Resident) — the general observation window — is the last 14 days after admission/entry or reentry (p. O-3); Item Rationale also refers to "the 14-day look-back period" (p. O-2). Column a (On Admission) uses days 1–3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B, and column c (At Discharge) uses the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending with A2400C (p. O-3). Separately, the F1 coding tip references residents weaned off a respirator/ventilator "in the last 14 days" (p. O-5). The document does not state that the window is counted as ARD plus prior days for this item.

coding_levels.label: Invasive Mechanical Ventilator — On Admission
coding_levels.definition: Check if an invasive mechanical ventilator (ventilator or respirator) was received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident on days 1–3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B.

source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident on days 1–3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B.

coding_levels.label: Invasive Mechanical Ventilator — While a Resident
coding_levels.definition: Check if an invasive mechanical ventilator (ventilator or respirator) was received or performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the last 14 days.

source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs that the resident received or performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the last 14 days.

coding_levels.label: Invasive Mechanical Ventilator — At Discharge
coding_levels.definition: Check if an invasive mechanical ventilator (ventilator or respirator) was received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident in the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending with A2400C.

source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident in the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending with A2400C.

coding_levels.label: None of the above
coding_levels.definition: Code if none of the listed treatments, procedures, or programs (including invasive mechanical ventilator) were received or performed by the resident in the applicable column's assessment period.

source.quote: Code if none of the above treatments, procedures, or programs were received or performed by the resident.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Code in O0110F1 any type of electrically or pneumatically powered closed-system mechanical ventilator support device that ensures adequate ventilation in a resident who is, or may become (such as during weaning attempts), unable to support their own respiration.

source.quote: Code any type of electrically or pneumatically powered closed-system mechanical ventilator support device that ensures adequate ventilation in the resident who is or who may become (such as during weaning attempts) unable to support their own respiration in this item.

federal_coding_rules.rule: During invasive mechanical ventilation the resident's breathing is controlled by the ventilator; residents receiving closed-system ventilation include those receiving ventilation via an endotracheal tube (nasally or orally intubated) or tracheostomy.

source.quote: During invasive mechanical ventilation the resident’s breathing is controlled by the ventilator. Residents receiving closed-system ventilation include those residents receiving ventilation via an endotracheal tube (e.g., nasally or orally intubated) or tracheostomy.

federal_coding_rules.rule: A resident who has been weaned off a respirator or ventilator in the last 14 days, or who is currently being weaned off a respirator or ventilator, should also be coded here.

source.quote: A resident who has been weaned off of a respirator or ventilator in the last 14 days or is currently being weaned off a respirator or ventilator, should also be coded here.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Do not code O0110F1 when the ventilator or respirator is used only as a substitute for BiPAP or CPAP.

source.quote: Do not code this item when the ventilator or respirator is used only as a substitute for BiPAP or CPAP.

federal_coding_rules.rule: When a ventilator or respirator is being used as a substitute for BiPAP/CPAP, it is coded in O0110G1 (Non-invasive Mechanical Ventilator) instead.

source.quote: If a ventilator or respirator is being used as a substitute for BiPAP/CPAP, code here.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Facilities may code treatments, programs and procedures that the resident performed themselves independently or after set-up by facility staff; do not code services provided solely in conjunction with a surgical or diagnostic procedure, such as IV medications or ventilators (surgical procedures include routine pre- and post-operative procedures).

source.quote: Facilities may code treatments, programs and procedures that the resident performed themselves independently or after set-up by facility staff. Do not code services that were provided solely in conjunction with a surgical procedure or diagnostic procedure, such as IV medications or ventilators. Surgical procedures include routine pre- and post-operative procedures.

federal_coding_rules.rule: If no treatments, procedures, or programs were received or performed in a column's assessment period, check Z, None of the above for that column.

source.quote: If no treatments, procedures or programs were received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident within the last 14 days or since admission/entry or reentry, check Z, None of the above.

federal_coding_rules.rule: An invasive mechanical ventilator delivering an FiO2 exceeding 40% may also be counted as a high-concentration oxygen delivery system for O0110C4.

source.quote: These devices may also include invasive mechanical ventilators, non-invasive mechanical ventilators, or trach masks, if the delivered FiO2 of these systems exceeds 40%.

federal.criterion: Review the resident's medical record to determine whether or not the resident received or performed the treatment, procedure, or program within the assessment period defined for each column.

source.quote: Review the resident’s medical record to determine whether or not the resident received or performed any of the treatments, procedures, or programs within the assessment period defined for each column.

federal.notes: Only documentation step stated for O0110; no item-specific documentation requirements are given for O0110F1.

case_mix_relevance.notes: The pages for O0110F define assessment periods relative to the SNF PPS Stay (A2400B/A2400C) but do not explicitly tie O0110F1 to a payment or case-mix classification.

conflicts.topic: Coexisting assessment/look-back windows for O0110F (14 days for column b vs. 3-day windows for columns a and c)

positions.claim: Column b (While a Resident) uses a 14-day observation window after admission/entry or reentry.

source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs that the resident received or performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the last 14 days.

positions.claim: Column a (On Admission) uses a 3-day assessment period: days 1–3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B.

source.quote: Assessment period is days 1 through 3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B

positions.claim: Column c (At Discharge) uses a 3-day assessment period: the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending on A2400C.

source.quote: Assessment period is the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending on A2400C

conflicts.resolution: Resolved by the document: each column carries its own stated assessment period (a = days 1–3 of the SNF PPS Stay; b = last 14 days; c = last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay). lookback_days records the 14-day column b observation window.
